_comment: FastSpeech2 training config for JSUT 5000 utt (Phase T.4a + Phase E-next-4)

model._comment: Phase T.4b-B: CPU 学習用軽量 config (hidden 192, layers 3)、期待 2-3× 加速

audio._comment: 48 kHz JSUT native, n_fft 2048, hop 512 = 10.67 ms/frame (24kHz+hop256 と同 frame rate)

dataset._comment: JSUT 5000 utt, 90/5/5 split, batch=1 (Phase E-next-3 で variable-length 対応済だが fs2_train.rs は batch=1 前提)

training._comment: AdamW lr=1e-4, checkpoint 5000 step 毎 (Free A6000 6h session で ~15k step 進行想定)

eval._comment: Eval loss + サンプル数 wav 生成 (次 Phase で追加)
